description: Delete a file or folder: it is moved under .trash/<time>/ in your workspace (keeping its path; a path outside the workspace is kept as its absolute path), so move can bring it back; use remove to delete for real. Returns JSON {path, to}. Errors: PathBad, FileMissing, MoveFailed. Details: knowledge_read aos/tools/trash.json.

path.description: path to delete, relative to your workspace, or absolute
